title: 596. Convert BST to Greater Tree

examples.explanation: Each node becomes its own value plus all larger values (e.g. 4 becomes 30).
The node 1 keeps 1; the node 0 absorbs it and becomes 1.
Node 2 keeps 2, node 1 becomes 3, node 0 becomes 3.
